notes.title: The Hungry Ghost Festival has begun!
notes.content:
A spooky hello to everyone!


Some of you might know the Hungry Ghost Festival already. But if you don't, have a glimpse into South East Asian culture on Steam! Among other games, Rottenroots is featured to celebrate the Hungry Ghost Festival and indulge in horror and spookiness for a while.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312745/4c6ca8e159479e4c25567d5332f0d714e095f97f.png"]

So, take a step closer and explore Salem's world in our free demo. Will he survive a Sundown? 

And stay tuned for our full release next year, if you want to uncover the mysteries below the camp!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3177730/Rottenroots/"][/dynamiclink]

Have fun with the festivities and some horror vibes!



[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Kz5AzZVbfEc?feature=shared"][/dynamiclink]
-Your friends at Klabautermann Games
